title: IFC-MCQ: Automatically Generating Multiple-Choice Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Agents on IFC Data Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.30533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC), the standard for building information exchange in architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC), is increasingly queried through large language models (LLMs) using natural language. Evaluating these systems at scale is difficult because free-text answers require costly human or LLM-based review. We propose IFC-MCQ, a method that automatically generates multiple-choice benchmarks from IFC files for exact option-set grading. The taxonomy covers 15 categories and 36 subtypes across four groups, with answer keys derived from the file and distractors constructed from file-derived values or predefined rules. We applied IFC-MCQ to IFC models of varying sizes and modelling characteristics to assess generation coverage and evaluated two agentic configurations on selected models using tool- and code-based retrieval. translated_title: IFC-MCQ：自动生成多项选择题基准，用于评估大语言模型智能体的IFC数据检索能力
translated_abstract: 行业基础类（IFC）是建筑工程（AEC）领域建筑信息交换的标准，如今越来越多地通过大语言模型（LLM）以自然语言进行查询。由于自由文本答案需要昂贵的人工或基于LLM的审查，大规模评估这些系统十分困难。我们提出IFC-MCQ，一种从IFC文件自动生成多项选择题基准的方法，可实现精确的选项集评分。该分类法涵盖四个组别下的15个类别和36个子类型，其中答案键直接源自文件本身，干扰项则由文件派生的值或预定义规则构建。我们将IFC-MCQ应用于不同规模和建模特征的IFC模型以评估生成覆盖率，并使用基于工具和基于代码的检索方法在选定模型上评估了两种智能体配置。该评估揭示了特定类别的失败模式，并表明性能可能因（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出IFC-MCQ方法，从IFC文件自动生成多项选择题基准并实现精确自动评分，从而以低成本大规模评估LLM智能体在IFC数据检索上的能力。
en_tdlr: IFC-MCQ automatically generates multiple-choice benchmarks from IFC files, enabling exact option-set grading for scalable and low-cost evaluation of LLM agents on IFC data retrieval.
